interpretation: Descriptive paired percentile-bootstrap intervals conditional on the frozen models and this dataset; approximate simultaneous coverage is adjusted within each seed, not across seeds. Repeated splits share users and items, and one MovieLens dataset does not establish population-level or cross-dataset gains. No model or parameter is selected using these evaluation outcomes.
